description: Germany visit visa from Pakistan (Schengen): requirements, documents, fees, processing time, invitation letters, common mistakes and FAQ. SK Immigration Services, Rawalpindi.

faqs.question: Germany visit visa requirements from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Passport, form, insurance €30k+, funds, itinerary/invitation, and proof you will return. SK Immigration builds a complete file from PKR 30,000.

faqs.question: Do I need an invitation for Germany?
faqs.answer: Helpful for family visits; tourists can use hotel bookings. Formal Verpflichtungserklärung strengthens some family cases.

faqs.question: How much bank balance for Germany visit?
faqs.answer: Enough for trip length plus ties evidence — not a single magic number. We review statements honestly.

faqs.question: Schengen visa validity?
faqs.answer: Often short stays up to 90 days in 180-day period — exact validity is decided by the mission.

faqs.question: Can I work on Germany visit visa?
faqs.answer: No. Work needs a work/national visa. Visit is tourism/family/business meetings only.

faqs.question: SK guarantee?
faqs.answer: No. Consulates decide. We prepare strong, honest files.

Germany visit visa from Pakistan

SK Immigration Services helps Pakistani applicants prepare Germany visit visa files for tourism, family visit, business meetings. Embassies decide outcomes — we prepare complete, honest applications.

Who this page is for

Candidates searching for Germany visit visa requirements from Pakistan, documents, fees, processing time, invitation letters, refusal reasons and how to apply — with SK Immigration as their consultant in Rawalpindi.

Requirements

  • Passport valid 3+ months beyond stay with blank pages
  • Schengen form, photos, appointment confirmation
  • Travel medical insurance minimum €30,000 coverage
  • Flight/hotel itinerary or invitation letter (Verpflichtungserklärung if applicable)
  • Bank statements and employment/business proof showing Pakistan ties
  • Cover letter explaining purpose and return plan

Process — how to apply

  1. Purpose assessment (tourist / family / business)
  2. Document checklist and invitation review
  3. Insurance and itinerary packaging
  4. VFS appointment readiness
  5. Biometrics and decision tracking

Documents checklist

  • Passport, photos, form
  • Insurance policy
  • Itinerary / invitation
  • 6-month bank statements (typical)
  • Salary slips / NTN / business docs
  • Property / family ties evidence

Fees

SK visit support from PKR 30,000. VFS/embassy fees and insurance separate.

Processing time / timeline

Often 2–6 weeks after biometrics; peak summer/winter longer.

Common mistakes & refusal risks

  • Weak Pakistan ties (job/family/property unexplained)
  • Insurance below Schengen minimum
  • Overstay history or inconsistent travel story
  • Using visit visa intending to work/study long-term

Related services

All visit visas · Work permits · Visa appointments · Study visas · Free consultation

Germany visit visa from Pakistan — VFS national vs Schengen visit distinction

Germany Schengen visits cover tourism, family and business short stays. Long study or Ausbildung needs a national visa — not a tourist Schengen file.

Where Pakistanis apply (Germany)

German Schengen short-stay applications from Pakistan are submitted through VFS Global Germany.

Centres: Islamabad · Karachi. Confirm the live centre list before paying travel costs to a VAC city.

Tourism visits

City and regional plans; Christmas-market season peaks tighten slots.

Family visits

Verpflichtungserklärung or host paperwork when applicable; verify current forms.

Business visitor (short meetings)

Trade fair (Messe) or supplier visits with dated bilateral letters.

Pakistan-side refusal risks

  • Using Schengen visit to enter for Ausbildung/job hunt
  • Insurance not covering full Schengen period
  • Main destination actually another country
  • Ignoring prior Schengen refusals

Funds and credibility

Blocked-account logic applies to students — not tourists. Tourists need liquid funds matching trip + Pakistan life.

Visit vs study / work

Short visits cannot replace student residence or work permits. For degrees see Germany study visa. Work needs correct authorization — work permit hub.

Official Germany links · Germany visit checklist · refusal reasons · appointment guides

Cover letter outline (Germany visit from Pakistan)

  1. Your role in Pakistan (job, business, study) with contactable employer
  2. Exact travel dates aligned with insurance and hotel/invite
  3. Day-level plan for Germany cities — not a generic “Europe tour”
  4. Who pays, with six-month bank trail explaining any large deposits
  5. Why you return (dependents, property, business continuity, studies)
  6. Prior visas/refusals stated calmly with what changed

First-time travellers from Pakistan

No prior visas is not automatic refusal, but first files need clearer employment proof and realistic trip length. Prior compliant Schengen/UK/US travel helps when explained; unexplained gaps hurt.

Children and family groups

Carry birth certificates and school leave letters. Group itineraries must show every traveller’s ties — not only the primary applicant’s job letter.

After a refusal

Read the refusal letter themes before reapplying. Fixing only the appointment slot without stronger purpose, funds or ties usually fails again. See visit refusal reasons and what next.
